   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN

    iState := 90; (* EMERGENCY_SHIELD_SEAL_AND_FACE_PRESSURE_ISOLATION *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Tripped *)
END_IF;

IF rHydraulicLinePressure < 180.0 THEN
    (* Hydraulic Supply Pressure Deficient - Hazard to Shield Support *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Hydraulic Main Pressure Low Fault *)
    IF iState >= 40 AND iState <= 70 THEN
        iState := 90; (* Abort to emergency seal *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord AND NOT 16#0002;
END_IF;

IF NOT bInterlockSlurryFlow AND (iState = 50 OR iState = 60) THEN
    (* Loss of bentonite circulation circuit flow - Risk of chamber sedimentation *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Slurry Circulation Permissive Lost *)
    iState := 70; (* Fallback to Ring Build Standby Pressure Retention *)
ELSE
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord AND NOT 16#0004;
END_IF;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 1: IEC 61508 / IEC 61511 SIL-3 2oo3 TMR SENSOR VOTING LOGIC & DEGRADATION ENGINE
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* --- 1.1 Crown Slurry Pressure Triad (PT-101A, PT-101B, PT-101C) --- *)
(* Range Validation [0.5 bar to 12.0 bar] *)
bCrown_Ch1_Valid := (rPressCrown_Ch1 >= 0.50) AND (rPressCrown_Ch1 <= 12.00);
bCrown_Ch2_Valid := (rPressCrown_Ch2 >= 0.50) AND (rPressCrown_Ch2 <= 12.00);
bCrown_Ch3_Valid := (rPressCrown_Ch3 >= 0.50) AND (rPressCrown_Ch3 <= 12.00);

(* Pairwise Disparity Calculation *)
rCrown_Delta12 := ABS(rPressCrown_Ch1 - rPressCrown_Ch2);
rCrown_Delta23 := ABS(rPressCrown_Ch2 - rPressCrown_Ch3);
rCrown_Delta31 := ABS(rPressCrown_Ch3 - rPressCrown_Ch1);

(* Persistent Discrepancy Fault Timers (50 ms filter to reject transient electrical noise) *)
tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer(IN := (rCrown_Delta12 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit AND rCrown_Delta31 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bCrown_Ch1_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer(IN := (rCrown_Delta12 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit AND rCrown_Delta23 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bCrown_Ch2_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer(IN := (rCrown_Delta23 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit AND rCrown_Delta31 > rCrownDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bCrown_Ch3_Valid, PT := T#50MS);

(* Crown Pressure Voting Engine and Graceful Degradation *)
IF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* All 3 Channels Healthy: Median Selection 2oo3 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 0;
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rPressCrown_Ch1;
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rPressCrown_Ch2;
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rPressCrown_Ch3;
    (* 3-element sorting network *)
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3]; rMedianBuffer[3] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedFacePressure := rMedianBuffer[2];
    wDegradedSensorWord := wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007;

ELSIF tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Channel 1 Degraded: 1oo2 Average of Ch2 & Ch3 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedFacePressure := 0.5 * (rPressCrown_Ch2 + rPressCrown_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0001; (* Bit 0: Crown Ch1 Fail *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Channel 2 Degraded: 1oo2 Average of Ch1 & Ch3 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedFacePressure := 0.5 * (rPressCrown_Ch1 + rPressCrown_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0002; (* Bit 1: Crown Ch2 Fail *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Channel 3 Degraded: 1oo2 Average of Ch1 & Ch2 *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedFacePressure := 0.5 * (rPressCrown_Ch1 + rPressCrown_Ch2);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0004; (* Bit 2: Crown Ch3 Fail *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    (* Double Fault: Only Channel 1 Survives - 1oo1 Critical Mode *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedFacePressure := rPressCrown_Ch1;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0006; (* Ch2 & Ch3 Failed *)
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0008; (* Bit 3: Face Pressure 2oo3 Degraded to 1oo1 *)

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iCrownDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedFacePressure := rPressCrown_Ch2;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0005;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0008;

ELSIF NOT tCrown_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iCrownDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedFacePressure := rPressCrown_Ch3;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0007) OR 16#0003;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0008;

ELSE
    (* Triple Fault: Catastrophic Loss of All Crown Pressure Transmitters *)
    iCrownDegradedMode := 3;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0010; (* Bit 4: Total Crown Transmitter Loss Trip *)
    iState := 90; (* Emergency trip *)
END_IF;

(* Convert Crown Pressure to Axis Pressure using hydrostatic slurry column *)
(* p_axis = p_crown + rho_slurry * g * rCrownToAxisDistance *)
rVotedFacePressure := rVotedFacePressure + (rSlurryDensity_Inlet * rGravity * rCrownToAxisDistance) / 100000.0;

(* --- 1.2 Air Bubble Chamber Pressure Triad (PT-201A, PT-201B, PT-201C) --- *)
bBubble_Ch1_Valid := (rPressBubble_Ch1 >= 0.50) AND (rPressBubble_Ch1 <= 12.00);
bBubble_Ch2_Valid := (rPressBubble_Ch2 >= 0.50) AND (rPressBubble_Ch2 <= 12.00);
bBubble_Ch3_Valid := (rPressBubble_Ch3 >= 0.50) AND (rPressBubble_Ch3 <= 12.00);

rBubble_Delta12 := ABS(rPressBubble_Ch1 - rPressBubble_Ch2);
rBubble_Delta23 := ABS(rPressBubble_Ch2 - rPressBubble_Ch3);
rBubble_Delta31 := ABS(rPressBubble_Ch3 - rPressBubble_Ch1);

tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer(IN := (rBubble_Delta12 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit AND rBubble_Delta31 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bBubble_Ch1_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer(IN := (rBubble_Delta12 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit AND rBubble_Delta23 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bBubble_Ch2_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer(IN := (rBubble_Delta23 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit AND rBubble_Delta31 > rBubbleDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bBubble_Ch3_Valid, PT := T#50MS);

IF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 0;
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rPressBubble_Ch1;

        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;

ELSIF tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedBubblePressure := 0.5 * (rPressBubble_Ch2 + rPressBubble_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0010;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedBubblePressure := 0.5 * (rPressBubble_Ch1 + rPressBubble_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0020;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedBubblePressure := 0.5 * (rPressBubble_Ch1 + rPressBubble_Ch2);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0040;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedBubblePressure := rPressBubble_Ch1;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0060;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0020; (* Bit 5: Bubble Pressure 2oo3 Degraded to 1oo1 *)

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedBubblePressure := rPressBubble_Ch2;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0050;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0020;

ELSIF NOT tBubble_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iBubbleDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedBubblePressure := rPressBubble_Ch3;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0070) OR 16#0030;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0020;

ELSE

    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Total Bubble Transmitter Loss Trip *)

(* --- 1.3 Slurry Surface Level Triad (LT-301A, LT-301B, LT-301C) --- *)

rLevel_Delta31 := ABS(rLevelBubble_Ch3 - rLevelBubble_Ch1);

tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer(IN := (rLevel_Delta12 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit AND rLevel_Delta31 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bLevel_Ch1_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer(IN := (rLevel_Delta12 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit AND rLevel_Delta23 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bLevel_Ch2_Valid, PT := T#50MS);
tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer(IN := (rLevel_Delta23 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit AND rLevel_Delta31 > rLevelDiscrepancyLimit) OR NOT bLevel_Ch3_Valid, PT := T#50MS);

IF NOT tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 0;
    rMedianBuffer[1] := rLevelBubble_Ch1;
    rMedianBuffer[2] := rLevelBubble_Ch2;
    rMedianBuffer[3] := rLevelBubble_Ch3;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[2] > rMedianBuffer[3] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rMedianBuffer[3]; rMedianBuffer[3] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    IF rMedianBuffer[1] > rMedianBuffer[2] THEN
        rTemp := rMedianBuffer[1]; rMedianBuffer[1] := rMedianBuffer[2]; rMedianBuffer[2] := rTemp;
    END_IF;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := rMedianBuffer[2];
    wDegradedSensorWord := wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700;

ELSIF tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := 0.5 * (rLevelBubble_Ch2 + rLevelBubble_Ch3);

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := 0.5 * (rLevelBubble_Ch1 + rLevelBubble_Ch3);
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0200;

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch1_FaultTimer.Q AND NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q AND tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 1;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := 0.5 * (rLevelBubble_Ch1 + rLevelBubble_Ch2);

    rVotedSlurryLevel := rLevelBubble_Ch1;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0600;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0080; (* Bit 7: Bubble Level 2oo3 Degraded to 1oo1 *)

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch2_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := rLevelBubble_Ch2;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0500;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0080;

ELSIF NOT tLevel_Ch3_FaultTimer.Q THEN
    iLevelDegradedMode := 2;
    rVotedSlurryLevel := rLevelBubble_Ch3;
    wDegradedSensorWord := (wDegradedSensorWord AND NOT 16#0700) OR 16#0300;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0080;

ELSE
    iLevelDegradedMode := 3;
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0100; (* Bit 8: Total Level Transmitter Loss Trip *)
    iState := 90;
END_IF;

bDegradedSensorMode := (iCrownDegradedMode > 0) OR (iBubbleDegradedMode > 0) OR (iLevelDegradedMode > 0);

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 2: TERZAGHI SUB-AQUEOUS GEOTECHNICAL EQUILIBRIUM & TARGET PRESSURE SYNTHESIS
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Calculate total pore water pressure at tunnel springline axis [kPa] *)
(* u_w = rho_water * g * (H_water_depth + h_tidal + Overburden + R_shield) *)
rHydrostaticWaterHead := 1025.0 * rGravity * (rWaterDepthMean_m + rTidalWaterLevel_m + rOverburdenDepth_m + rCrownToAxisDistance) / 1000.0;

(* Calculate vertical effective stress of soil overburden [kPa] *)
(* gamma_submerged = gamma_saturated - gamma_water = (20.5 - 10.05) kN/m3 = 10.45 kN/m3 *)
rEffectiveOverburdenStress := 10.45 * rOverburdenDepth_m;

(* Lateral Earth Pressure Coefficient at Rest: K_0 = 1 - sin(phi) *)
rLateralEarthPressureCoeff := 1.0 - SIN(rSoilFrictionAngle_deg * rPI / 180.0);

(* Total Target Face Support Pressure at Axis [bar] *)
(* p_target = (u_w + K_0 * sigma_v' + Delta_safety) / 100.0 *)
rCalculatedTargetFacePressure := (rHydrostaticWaterHead + (rLateralEarthPressureCoeff * rEffectiveOverburdenStress) + 25.0) / 100.0;

(* Determine Face Pressure Control Error *)
bFacePressureInTolerance := ABS(rVotedFacePressure - rFaceSupportPressure_SP) <= 0.015; (* Sub-millibar +-15 mbar *)

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 3: BUBBLE CHAMBER STATE-SPACE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Disturbance Vector Construction *)
aDisturbance_d[1] := rAdvanceRate_Actual / 60000.0; (* [m/s] *)
aDisturbance_d[2] := rSlurryFeedFlow_Meas / 3600.0;  (* [m3/s] *)
aDisturbance_d[3] := rSlurryDischargeFlow_Meas / 3600.0; (* [m3/s] *)

(* Measurement Vector: y_meas = [ p_bubble [bar], dp_bubble/dt [bar/s], h_slurry [m], Q_net [m3/s] ] *)
aState_x[1] := rVotedBubblePressure;
aState_x[2] := (rVotedBubblePressure - aState_x_prev[1]) / rDt;
aState_x[3] := rVotedSlurryLevel / 1000.0; (* mm to m *)
aState_x[4] := aDisturbance_d[2] - aDisturbance_d[3];

(* Luenberger State Observer Update *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        rSum := rSum + matA[i, j] * aState_x_est[j];
    END_FOR;
    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
        rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aControl_u[j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
    END_FOR;
    (* Add innovation correction: L * (y_meas - C * x_est) *)
    rSum := rSum + matL[i, 1] * (aState_x[1] - aState_x_est[1])
                 + matL[i, 3] * (aState_x[3] - aState_x_est[3]);
    aState_x_next[i] := rSum;
END_FOR;
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aState_x_est[i] := aState_x_next[i];
END_FOR;

(* Target State Vector r = [ p_bubble_target, 0, h_slurry_target, 0 ] *)
(* Dynamic relation: p_bubble_target = rFaceSupportPressure_SP - (rho_slurry * g * (h_axis - h_slurry)) / 100000 *)
aTargetState_r[1] := rFaceSupportPressure_SP - (rSlurryDensity_Inlet * rGravity * (rCrownToAxisDistance - (rVotedSlurryLevel / 1000.0))) / 100000.0;
aTargetState_r[2] := 0.0;
aTargetState_r[3] := 2.150; (* Target optimal bubble slurry level 2.15 m *)
aTargetState_r[4] := 0.0;

(* --- Real-Time Projected Gradient Descent MPC Solver --- *)
(* Initialize predicted trajectories with previous control commands *)
FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aPredicted_u[1, i] := aControl_u[i];
    aPredicted_u[2, i] := aControl_u[i];
    aPredicted_u[3, i] := aControl_u[i];
END_FOR;

rBestCost_J := 1.0E9;
FOR iMpcIter := 1 TO iMaxMpcIter DO
    (* 1. Forward propagate state predictions over N_p = 5 steps *)
    FOR k_step := 1 TO 5 DO
        FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
            IF k_step = 1 THEN
                rSum := 0.0;
                FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
                    rSum := rSum + matA[i, j] * aState_x_est[j];
                END_FOR;
                FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
                    rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aPredicted_u[1, j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
                END_FOR;
                aPredicted_x[1, i] := rSum;
            ELSE
                rSum := 0.0;
                FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
                    rSum := rSum + matA[i, j] * aPredicted_x[k_step - 1, j];
                END_FOR;
                (* For steps beyond control horizon N_u = 3, hold last control input *)
                IF k_step <= 3 THEN
                    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
                        rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aPredicted_u[k_step, j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
                    END_FOR;
                ELSE
                    FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
                        rSum := rSum + matB[i, j] * aPredicted_u[3, j] + matE[i, j] * aDisturbance_d[j];
                    END_FOR;
                END_IF;
                aPredicted_x[k_step, i] := rSum;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* 2. Evaluate Quadratic Cost Function J *)
    rQuadraticCost_J := 0.0;
    FOR k_step := 1 TO 5 DO
        FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
            rTemp := aPredicted_x[k_step, i] - aTargetState_r[i];
            rQuadraticCost_J := rQuadraticCost_J + aWeight_Q[i] * (rTemp * rTemp);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    FOR k_step := 1 TO 3 DO
        FOR j := 1 TO 3 DO
            IF k_step = 1 THEN
                rTemp := aPredicted_u[1, j] - aControl_u_prev[j];
            ELSE
                rTemp := aPredicted_u[k_step, j] - aPredicted_u[k_step - 1, j];
            END_IF;
            rQuadraticCost_J := rQuadraticCost_J + aWeight_R[j] * (rTemp * rTemp);
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* 3. Compute Cost Gradients with respect to first control step u(k) *)
    (* Gradient component for charging valve *)
    aGradient_g[1] := 2.0 * matB[1, 1] * aWeight_Q[1] * (aPredicted_x[1, 1] - aTargetState_r[1])
                    + 2.0 * aWeight_R[1] * (aPredicted_u[1, 1] - aControl_u_prev[1]);
    (* Gradient component for venting valve *)
    aGradient_g[2] := 2.0 * matB[1, 2] * aWeight_Q[1] * (aPredicted_x[1, 1] - aTargetState_r[1])
                    + 2.0 * aWeight_R[2] * (aPredicted_u[1, 2] - aControl_u_prev[2]);
    (* Gradient component for bypass flow *)
    aGradient_g[3] := 2.0 * matB[3, 3] * aWeight_Q[3] * (aPredicted_x[1, 3] - aTargetState_r[3])
                    + 2.0 * aWeight_R[3] * (aPredicted_u[1, 3] - aControl_u_prev[3]);

    (* 4. Update and Project Controls (Steepest Descent with Box Projection) *)
    aPredicted_u[1, 1] := aPredicted_u[1, 1] - rGradStepSize * aGradient_g[1];
    aPredicted_u[1, 2] := aPredicted_u[1, 2] - rGradStepSize * aGradient_g[2];
    aPredicted_u[1, 3] := aPredicted_u[1, 3] - rGradStepSize * aGradient_g[3];

    (* Project Charging Valve: [0.0% to 100.0%] and Slew Rate Limit *)
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 1] < rChargeValve_Min THEN aPredicted_u[1, 1] := rChargeValve_Min; END_IF;
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 1] > rChargeValve_Max THEN aPredicted_u[1, 1] := rChargeValve_Max; END_IF;
    IF (aPredicted_u[1, 1] - aControl_u_prev[1]) > (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 1] := aControl_u_prev[1] + (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    ELSIF (aPredicted_u[1, 1] - aControl_u_prev[1]) < -(rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 1] := aControl_u_prev[1] - (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    END_IF;

    (* Project Venting Valve: [0.0% to 100.0%] and Slew Rate Limit *)
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 2] < rVentValve_Min THEN aPredicted_u[1, 2] := rVentValve_Min; END_IF;
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 2] > rVentValve_Max THEN aPredicted_u[1, 2] := rVentValve_Max; END_IF;
    IF (aPredicted_u[1, 2] - aControl_u_prev[2]) > (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 2] := aControl_u_prev[2] + (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    ELSIF (aPredicted_u[1, 2] - aControl_u_prev[2]) < -(rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt) THEN
        aPredicted_u[1, 2] := aControl_u_prev[2] - (rValveSlewRateLimit * rDt);
    END_IF;

    (* Project Bypass Flow: [-350 m3/h to +350 m3/h] *)
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 3] < rBypassFlow_Min THEN aPredicted_u[1, 3] := rBypassFlow_Min; END_IF;
    IF aPredicted_u[1, 3] > rBypassFlow_Max THEN aPredicted_u[1, 3] := rBypassFlow_Max; END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Extract First Step Optimal Controls *)
aControl_u[1] := aPredicted_u[1, 1];
aControl_u[2] := aPredicted_u[1, 2];
aControl_u[3] := aPredicted_u[1, 3];

(* Split-Range Valve Overlap Elimination (Deadband Enforcement) *)
IF aControl_u[1] > rPneumaticSplitDeadband AND aControl_u[2] > rPneumaticSplitDeadband THEN
    IF aControl_u[1] >= aControl_u[2] THEN
        aControl_u[1] := aControl_u[1] - aControl_u[2];
        aControl_u[2] := 0.0;
    ELSE
        aControl_u[2] := aControl_u[2] - aControl_u[1];
        aControl_u[1] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Assign Physical Actuator Outputs from MPC *)
IF iState = 60 OR iState = 70 OR iState = 30 THEN
    rAirChargeValve_Cmd   := aControl_u[1];
    rAirVentValve_Cmd     := aControl_u[2];
    rSlurryBypassFlow_Cmd := aControl_u[3];
ELSE
    rAirChargeValve_Cmd   := 0.0;
    rAirVentValve_Cmd     := 0.0;
    rSlurryBypassFlow_Cmd := 0.0;
END_IF;

FOR i := 1 TO 3 DO
    aControl_u_prev[i] := aControl_u[i];
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 4: MULTI-ZONE HYDRAULIC THRUST CYLINDER ADVANCE SYNCHRONIZATION (CROSS-COUPLING)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Raw Stroke Feedback Mapping *)
aZoneStroke_Raw[1] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneA;
aZoneStroke_Raw[2] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneB;
aZoneStroke_Raw[3] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneC;
aZoneStroke_Raw[4] := rCylinderStroke_ZoneD;

(* Filter Cylinder Strokes and Compute Velocities via Filtered Differentiator *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aZoneStroke_Filt[i] := aZoneStroke_Filt[i] + rVelFilter_Alpha * (aZoneStroke_Raw[i] - aZoneStroke_Filt[i]);
    aZoneVelocity_Raw[i] := (aZoneStroke_Filt[i] - aZoneStroke_Prev[i]) / rDt * 60.0; (* [mm/min] *)
    aZoneVelocity_Filt[i] := aZoneVelocity_Filt[i] + rVelFilter_Alpha * (aZoneVelocity_Raw[i] - aZoneVelocity_Filt[i]);
    aZoneStroke_Prev[i] := aZoneStroke_Filt[i];
END_FOR;

rAdvanceRate_Actual := 0.25 * (aZoneVelocity_Filt[1] + aZoneVelocity_Filt[2] + aZoneVelocity_Filt[3] + aZoneVelocity_Filt[4]);

(* Integrate Virtual Master Stroke *)
IF (iState = 60) AND NOT bRingErectionHoldMode THEN
    rMasterStroke_Virtual := rMasterStroke_Virtual + (rTargetAdvanceVelocity / 60.0) * rDt;
END_IF;

(* Geometric Decoupling for Steering Trajectory (Pitch and Yaw) *)
(* Delta_s_pitch = D_pitch * tan(theta_pitch) ~= D_pitch * theta_pitch [mrad -> mm] *)
rPitchDeltaStroke_Cmd := (rPitchCylinderDiameter * 1000.0) * (rTargetPitchAngle_mrad / 1000.0);
rYawDeltaStroke_Cmd   := (rPitchCylinderDiameter * 1000.0) * (rTargetYawAngle_mrad / 1000.0);

aZoneStroke_Target[1] := rMasterStroke_Virtual + (0.5 * rPitchDeltaStroke_Cmd); (* Zone A (Crown) *)
aZoneStroke_Target[3] := rMasterStroke_Virtual - (0.5 * rPitchDeltaStroke_Cmd); (* Zone C (Invert) *)
aZoneStroke_Target[2] := rMasterStroke_Virtual + (0.5 * rYawDeltaStroke_Cmd);   (* Zone B (Right) *)
aZoneStroke_Target[4] := rMasterStroke_Virtual - (0.5 * rYawDeltaStroke_Cmd);   (* Zone D (Left) *)

(* Compute Individual Tracking Errors e_i *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aTrackingError_e[i] := aZoneStroke_Filt[i] - aZoneStroke_Target[i];
END_FOR;

(* Synthesize Cross-Coupling Synchronization Errors epsilon_i *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    rSum := 0.0;
    FOR j := 1 TO 4 DO
        IF i <> j THEN
            rSum := rSum + (aTrackingError_e[i] - aTrackingError_e[j]);
        END_IF;
    END_FOR;
    aSyncError_epsilon[i] := aTrackingError_e[i] + rCrossCouplingCoeff_alpha * rSum;
END_FOR;

(* Verify Spatial Synchronization Tolerance (< 2.0 mm peak deviation across all zones) *)
bThrustSynchronized := (ABS(aTrackingError_e[1] - aTrackingError_e[3]) <= 2.0) AND
                       (ABS(aTrackingError_e[2] - aTrackingError_e[4]) <= 2.0);

(* Multi-Zone PID Regulation and Pressure Command Synthesis *)
rTotalThrustForce_MN := 0.0;
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    (* Proportional Term *)
    aZonePID_P[i] := - rZone_Kp * aSyncError_epsilon[i];

    (* Integral Term with Anti-Windup Clamping *)
    IF (iState = 60) AND NOT bRingErectionHoldMode THEN
        aZonePID_I[i] := aZonePID_I[i] - (rZone_Kp / rZone_Ti) * aSyncError_epsilon[i] * rDt;
        IF aZonePID_I[i] > rZone_IntegralMax THEN aZonePID_I[i] := rZone_IntegralMax; END_IF;
        IF aZonePID_I[i] < rZone_IntegralMin THEN aZonePID_I[i] := rZone_IntegralMin; END_IF;
    ELSE
        aZonePID_I[i] := 0.0; (* Reset during standby *)
    END_IF;

    (* Derivative Term *)
    aZonePID_D[i] := - rZone_Kp * rZone_Td * (aSyncError_epsilon[i] - aZonePID_PrevError[i]) / rDt;
    aZonePID_PrevError[i] := aSyncError_epsilon[i];

    (* Total Pressure Allocation per Zone *)
    IF iState = 60 THEN
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := rBaseThrustPressure + aZonePID_P[i] + aZonePID_I[i] + aZonePID_D[i];
        (* Limit within safe structural hydraulic bounds [40 bar to 345 bar] *)
        IF aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] < 40.0 THEN aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 40.0; END_IF;
        IF aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] > 345.0 THEN aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 345.0; END_IF;
    ELSIF iState = 40 OR iState = 50 OR iState = 70 THEN
        (* Holding pressure during ring build or pre-load *)
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 65.0;
    ELSE
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Sum total thrust force: 12 cylinders per zone * piston area (dia 320 mm) *)
    (* Piston Area = PI/4 * (0.320)^2 = 0.08042 m2 per cylinder *)
    (* Force per zone = 12 * 0.08042 m2 * (p_bar * 100 kPa) = 12 * 0.08042 * p_bar * 0.1 MN *)
    rTotalThrustForce_MN := rTotalThrustForce_MN + (12.0 * 0.08042 * aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[i] * 0.1);
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 5: CUTTERHEAD HYDRO-MECHANICAL TORSIONAL VIBRATION ACTIVE DAMPING & LOAD BALANCING
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Convert Speed from RPM to Rad/s *)
rCutterheadSpeed_rads := rCutterheadSpeed_Meas * (2.0 * rPI / 60.0);
rCutterheadAccel_rads2 := (rCutterheadSpeed_rads - rCutterheadSpeed_Prev) / rDt;
rCutterheadSpeed_Prev := rCutterheadSpeed_rads;

(* 4th-Order IIR Bandpass Butterworth Filter Execution *)
(* Update input shift register *)
aIIR_x[4] := aIIR_x[3];
aIIR_x[3] := aIIR_x[2];
aIIR_x[2] := aIIR_x[1];
aIIR_x[1] := aIIR_x[0];
aIIR_x[0] := rCutterheadSpeed_rads;

(* Compute filtered output y[k] *)
rTemp := (b0_bp * aIIR_x[0]) + (b1_bp * aIIR_x[1]) + (b2_bp * aIIR_x[2]) + (b3_bp * aIIR_x[3]) + (b4_bp * aIIR_x[4])
       - (a1_bp * aIIR_y[1]) - (a2_bp * aIIR_y[2]) - (a3_bp * aIIR_y[3]) - (a4_bp * aIIR_y[4]);

aIIR_y[4] := aIIR_y[3];
aIIR_y[3] := aIIR_y[2];
aIIR_y[2] := aIIR_y[1];
aIIR_y[1] := rTemp;
aIIR_y[0] := rTemp;

rOmega_Oscillatory := aIIR_y[0];

(* Active Hydro-Mechanical Damping Torque Synthesis *)
(* T_damp = - Kad * omega_osc - Jvirt * d(omega_osc)/dt *)
rTemp2 := (aIIR_y[0] - aIIR_y[1]) / rDt; (* Derivative of oscillatory velocity *)
rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd := - (rDampingGain_Kad * rOmega_Oscillatory) - (rVirtualInertia_Jvirt * rTemp2);

(* Saturation Limiting *)
IF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd > rMaxDampingTorqueLimit THEN
    rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd := rMaxDampingTorqueLimit;
ELSIF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd < -rMaxDampingTorqueLimit THEN
    rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd := -rMaxDampingTorqueLimit;
END_IF;

(* Leaky Peak Detector for Torsional Oscillation Amplitude *)
IF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd > rTorsionalPeakPositive THEN
    rTorsionalPeakPositive := rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd;
ELSE
    rTorsionalPeakPositive := rTorsionalPeakPositive * rTorsionalDecayRate;
END_IF;

IF rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd < rTorsionalPeakNegative THEN
    rTorsionalPeakNegative := rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd;
ELSE
    rTorsionalPeakNegative := rTorsionalPeakNegative * rTorsionalDecayRate;
END_IF;

rCutterheadTorsionalOscillation_Amp := rTorsionalPeakPositive - rTorsionalPeakNegative;

(* High Torsional Vibration Alarm Threshold (> 3200 kNm peak-to-peak) *)
IF rCutterheadTorsionalOscillation_Amp > 3200.0 THEN
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0200; (* Bit 9: Torsional Resonance Critical Alert *)
ELSE
    wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord AND NOT 16#0200;
END_IF;

(* Active Load-Sharing Loop across 16 Drive Pinions *)
rSum := 0.0;
FOR i := 1 TO 16 DO
    rSum := rSum + aPinionTorques[i];
END_FOR;
aPinionTorque_Avg := rSum / 16.0;

FOR i := 1 TO 16 DO
    aPinionTorqueError[i] := aPinionTorque_Avg - aPinionTorques[i];
    IF iState = 50 OR iState = 60 THEN
        aPinionPID_I[i] := aPinionPID_I[i] + (rPinion_Kp / rPinion_Ti) * aPinionTorqueError[i] * rDt;
        IF aPinionPID_I[i] > rMaxPinionTrimLimit THEN aPinionPID_I[i] := rMaxPinionTrimLimit; END_IF;
        IF aPinionPID_I[i] < -rMaxPinionTrimLimit THEN aPinionPID_I[i] := -rMaxPinionTrimLimit; END_IF;
    ELSE
        aPinionPID_I[i] := 0.0;
    END_IF;
    aPinionTorqueTrim_Cmd[i] := (rPinion_Kp * aPinionTorqueError[i]) + aPinionPID_I[i];
END_FOR;

(* Update Previous State Vector for Next Execution Scan *)
FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
    aState_x_prev[i] := aState_x[i];
END_FOR;

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   MODULE 6: MULTI-STAGE OPERATIONAL STATE MACHINE (CASE MACHINE)
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#86400S);
iPreviousState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* COLD_BOOT_UNINITIALIZED *)
        wTBM_StatusWord := 16#0001; (* State 0 Active *)
        rAirChargeValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rAirVentValve_Cmd := 0.0;
        rSlurryBypassFlow_Cmd := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[1] := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[2] := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[3] := 0.0;
        aZoneThrustPressure_Cmd[4] := 0.0;
        rActiveDampingTorque_Cmd := 0.0;

        IF bEnableSystem AND bEmergencyStop AND (wTBM_AlarmWord = 16#0000) THEN
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to Sensor Calibration *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* SENSOR_TMR_INTEGRITY_CHECK_AND_ZERO_CALIBRATION *)
        wTBM_StatusWord := 16#0002;
        (* Verify all sensor triads are healthy and reading reasonable baseline hydrostatic levels *)
        IF NOT bDegradedSensorMode AND (tStateTimer.ET >= T#2S) THEN
            iState := 20; (* Slurry Pre-Pressurization *)
        ELSIF tStateTimer.ET >= T#10S THEN
            (* Timeout waiting for healthy sensor voting *)
            wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0400; (* Bit 10: Sensor Initialization Timeout *)
            iState := 99; (* Critical Lockout *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* SLURRY_LOOP_PRE_PRESSURIZATION_AND_BUBBLE_INFLATION *)
        wTBM_StatusWord := 16#0004;
        (* Fill air bubble chamber to nominal initial level and charge pressure *)
        IF bInterlockSlurryFlow THEN
            IF rVotedBubblePressure < (rCalculatedTargetFacePressure - 0.50) THEN
                rAirChargeValve_Cmd := 45.0;
                rAirVentValve_Cmd := 0.0;
            ELSE
                rAirChargeValve_Cmd := 10.0;
                iState := 30; (* Advance to Sub-Millibar Equilibration *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* SUB_MILLIBAR_AIR_CUSHION_STATIC_EQUILIBRATION *)
        wTBM_StatusWord := 16#0008;
        (* MPC actively regulates air cushion to sub-millibar target *)
        IF bFacePressureInTolerance AND (tStateTimer.ET >= T#5S) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Thrust Cylinder Pre-Load *)
        ELSIF tStateTimer.ET >= T#30S THEN
            wTBM_AlarmWord := wTBM_AlarmWord OR 16#0800; (* Bit 11: Pressure Equilibration Timeout *)
            iState := 99;
        END_IF;
